"# MASTER PROMPT: SOUL KNIGHT PREQUEL: ADVENTURE (SKPA)

## 1. Core Identity @COMMENT_BODY@ Elevator Pitch
Buatlah sebuah game Action RPG (ARPG) Dungeon Crawler berperspektif top-down dengan gaya visual Pixel Art 16-bit modern. Game ini ditujukan untuk platform Mobile (Android/iOS) dan PC. Fantasi pemain adalah menjadi seorang \"Knight muda\" yang terjebak dalam time loop, menjelajahi dungeon prosedural yang berubah setiap saat untuk mengumpulkan kekuatan elemental dan mengungkap misteri kehancuran dunia. Gameplay berfokus pada combat real-time yang cepat, koleksi 200+ senjata unik, dan progression RPG yang mendalam.

## 2. Core Loop Mechanic
Implementasikan loop gameplay utama berikut untuk sesi bermain 5-15 menit:
1. PREPARE (Town Hub): Pemain memilih senjata, mengupgrade skill, dan membeli potion.
2. ENTER DUNGEON: Memasuki dungeon prosedural yang terdiri dari 5-18 room.
3. COMBAT WAVES: Mengalahkan gelombang musuh di Combat Room.
4. LOOT @COMMENT_BODY@ CHOOSE: Mendapatkan loot dan memilih 1 dari 3 random upgrade/senjata setelah room clear.
5. BOSS FIGHT: Menghadapi boss unik dengan pola serangan berbeda di akhir dungeon.
6. REWARD @COMMENT_BODY@ RETURN: Mendapatkan Gold, XP, dan material, lalu kembali ke Town Hub.

## 3. Progression @COMMENT_BODY@ Economy
- **Character Stats:** HP, MP, STR (Physical Dmg), DEX (Crit Chance), AGI (Dodge), INT (Magic Dmg), VIT (Max HP). Max level 100.
- **Skill Tree:** 3 cabang (Warrior untuk Physical DPS, Guardian untuk Tank, Mage untuk Elemental).
- **Currency:** Gold (upgrade/craft), Gems (cosmetic/gacha), Materials (crafting).
- **Balancing:** Gunakan formula damage: `FinalDamage = BaseDmg × (1 + STR/100) × ElementMultiplier × RarityMultiplier × CritMult`. Terapkan sistem elemental (Fire, Water, Lightning, Nature, Dark, Light, Earth, Ice) dengan mekanisme kuat/lemah (1.5x / 0.7x damage).

## 4. Visual @COMMENT_BODY@ Audio Direction
- **Art Style:** Pixel Art 16-bit. Resolusi base 320x180 di-upscale. Karakter 32x32 px, senjata 24x24 px.
- **Color Palette:** Terbatas per biome (max 64 warna). Mood dark fantasy dengan sentuhan whimsical.
- **Lighting:** Dynamic 2D lighting dengan normal maps pada sprite utama.
- **Audio:** BGM chiptune dicampur orkestra. SFX responsif untuk hit, dodge, dan loot.

## 5. UI/UX Overview
- **Mobile HUD:** Virtual joystick di kiri (100px). Tombol Attack (70px, merah), Skill 1 @COMMENT_BODY@ 2 (50px), Dodge (50px, biru) di kanan.
- **Top Bar:** HP Bar (merah, 200px), MP Bar (biru, 150px), Mini-map (80x80 px) di pojok kanan atas.
- **UX Principle:** Tap-to-attack harus responsif < 100ms. Inventory maksimal 3 scroll. Auto-equip senjata DPS lebih tinggi (bisa di-toggle).
"

# 🤯 OMG — Oh My GitHub ### 🚀 One Prompt In. A Full Game or App Out. 🚀 [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-🔥%20works-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/denaidark/OhMyGithub?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/issues) [![GitHub Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Actions-automated-2088FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered%20by-OpenCode-111111?style=for-the-badge)](https://opencode.ai/) ```text ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ DESCRIBE IT → BUILD IT → TEST IT → PLAY IT ║ ║ ║ ║ One GitHub issue. One prompt. A complete project. ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝ ``` **No API keys to configure. No server to maintain. No local setup maze.**
--- ## 🤯 What Is OMG? > **Your GitHub issue becomes the product brief.** OMG (Oh My GitHub) is an automated GitHub Actions workflow for creating complete browser games and app projects from one natural-language prompt. Write what you want in an issue and add the `OpenCode` label. OpenCode checks out the project, uses the shared skills, builds the experience, runs tests, verifies the result, and publishes an immutable OmGithub project link from the finished commit. Yes, it creates the code. Yes, it runs the verification loop. Yes, it can expose the result in a temporary browser URL. ## 🧠 TL;DR 1. Open a GitHub issue. 2. Describe the game or app you want. 3. Add the `OpenCode` label to the issue. 4. Let GitHub Actions build, test, verify, and propose the result. ```text Your idea → GitHub issue → OpenCode → tests → immutable OmGithub project ``` ## ⚡ Quick Start Create an issue in your repository with a concrete request: ```text Build a neon asteroid game. Requirements: - Arrow-key movement - Score and restart button - Win and lose states - Responsive browser layout - Run tests and verify it in a browser ``` That is the whole user-facing workflow. GitHub Actions handles the runner, OpenCode handles implementation, and the workflow handles verification plus the immutable project commit. To run against an existing non-default branch, end the issue title with a `branch: ` directive. The directive selects the checkout and is removed before the issue body is sent to OpenCode: ```sh gh issue create \ --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub \ --title "Custom branch smoke test branch: codex/omgithub-site" \ --body "Build a tiny browser page." \ --label Goal \ --label OpenCode ``` The GitHub App validates the branch before dispatching. If the directive is absent, the repository default branch remains the target. ## 🌍 What Can You Build? | 🎯 Use case | ✨ Example | |---|---| | 🎮 Arcade games | Breakout, Space Invaders, Asteroids, Match-3 | | 🧩 Puzzle games | Word games, logic puzzles, card games | | 🏃 Interactive demos | Physics experiments, simulations, visual toys | | 📊 Dashboards | Filters, charts, status panels, analytics views | | 🛠️ Internal tools | Trackers, generators, small workflow apps | | 🌐 Landing pages | Product pages, portfolios, interactive showcases | | 🧪 Prototypes | Turn a product idea into a runnable proof of concept | | 📱 Browser apps | Responsive tools that work on desktop and mobile | ## 🧰 What Happens Automatically? > **The workflow is the product.** - 📥 Checks out your repository and the shared OpenCode skills. - 🏷️ Synchronizes `model/*` and `skill/*` labels. - 🧭 Reads issue labels to select the model and requested skills. - 🤖 Runs OpenCode against the current project. - 🧪 Runs a second verification prompt after implementation. - 🌐 Starts the app and checks the local runtime. - 🔗 Creates a temporary public preview URL when verification passes. - 🔀 Creates and pushes an `opencode/` branch. - 🕹️ Adds an `Open Project` link backed by the repository path, with full-commit links retained for compatibility. - 💬 Posts progress and access details back to the issue. - 🧹 Cleans up temporary tunnels and runner processes. ## 🏷️ Model and Skill Labels Labels let you control the workflow without editing YAML. ```text model/opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free skill/load-sketchfab-threejs skill/gauntlet-loop ``` The workflow validates the selected labels, passes them into OpenCode, and records the resolved model and skills in the run logs. Shared skills are discovered from: ```text .agents/skills//SKILL.md ``` ## 🔄 OpenCode Workflow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Trigger] --> B[Prepare project] B --> C[Run build.md] C --> D[Run verify.md] D --> E{Public app works?} E -- No --> F[Run public-app-fix.md] F --> E E -- Yes --> G[Run completion-report.md] G --> H{Screenshots exist?} H -- No --> I[Run screenshot-evidence.md] I --> H H -- Yes --> J[Commit and push] J --> K[Create immutable project link] K --> L[Publish report] L --> M[Complete] ``` ## 🏗️ Architecture ```text ┌──────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ GitHub issue │ ──▶ │ GitHub Actions │ ──▶ │ OpenCode │ │ + issue text │ │ runner + labels │ │ + .agents │ └──────────────┘ └─────────────────┘ └──────┬───────┘ │ ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ Build code Run tests Verify app │ │ │ └─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┘ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ Commit store + preview │ └────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 🔐 Security and Access - 🔑 You do not need to create or store a project-specific AI API key. - 🖥️ You do not need to operate a dedicated build server. - ☁️ Execution happens in GitHub Actions. - 🔒 Temporary SSH and preview access exists only for the workflow run. - 👀 Review the generated commit before integrating it. - 🛡️ Restrict who can apply the `OpenCode` label in repositories that accept public issues. > “No servers needed” means no servers for you to provision or maintain. The workflow still uses GitHub-hosted Actions infrastructure and temporary workflow services. ## 📁 Project Structure ```text 📦 OMG ├─ .github/workflows/opencode.yml # 🤖 Main issue-to-project workflow ├─ wiki/opencode.md # 📖 Workflow and session notes ├─ wiki/testing.md # 🧪 Verification guidance └─ AGENTS.md # 🧭 Repository instructions ``` ## 🧪 Local Validation Validate the workflow definition before pushing changes: ```sh actionlint .github/workflows/opencode.yml git diff --check ``` ## 🐛 Troubleshooting | Problem | What to check |

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')

    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build the requested “SOUL KNIGHT PREQUEL: ADVENTURE” as a polished, playable top-down pixel-art ARPG dungeon crawler in the empty `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround` web repo, targeting desktop and mobile browsers.

## Requirements
- Implement core loop: Town Hub → procedural dungeon (5–18 rooms) → combat waves → choose 1 of 3 upgrades/weapons → boss → rewards → return.
- Stats: HP, MP, STR, DEX, AGI, INT, VIT; max level 100; 3 skill branches (Warrior, Guardian, Mage).
- Damage formula: `FinalDamage = BaseDmg × (1 + STR/100) × ElementMultiplier × RarityMultiplier × CritMult`.
- 8 elements (Fire, Water, Lightning, Nature, Dark, Light, Earth, Ice) with 1.5× / 0.7× matchups.
- 200+ unique weapons, currencies (Gold, Gems, Materials), crafting/upgrades.
- Pixel-art 16-bit presentation, dark fantasy + whimsical, dynamic 2D lighting, chiptune/ orchestral-tinted audio.
- Mobile HUD: left joystick (~100px), Attack (~70px red), Skill 1/2 (~50px), Dodge (~50px blue), HP bar (~200px), MP (~150px), 80×80 minimap.
- Responsive UI, tap-to-attack <100ms, inventory max 3 scrolls, toggleable auto-equip of higher-DPS weapon.

## Decisions
- Implement as dependency-free static HTML/CSS/JS modules (no Vite/build step); runtime’s `default-start.mjs` supports a root `index.html`.
- Internal canvas resolution 480×270, scaled with `image-rendering: pixelated`.
- Bundled local pixel fonts: Press Start 2P and VT323 in `assets/fonts/`.
- Generated 224 deterministic weapons (96 common, 62 rare, 42 epic, 18 legendary, 6 mythic) with procedural icons and affixes.
- Added extra time-loop meta systems: Echoes/Obelisk permanent upgrades, revive-for-30-gems, partial gold retention on death, 4 biomes/bosses.
- Title button text is exactly `PLAY` so the runtime screenshot auto-start selector recognizes it.
- Town is an explorable scene with clickable buildings plus persistent bottom action dock; dungeon rooms use a layered node graph with path-choice cards and minimap.

## Work State
### Completed
- Repo inspected; no existing app code.
- Fonts downloaded/bundled.
- Created `js/util.js` (RNG, helpers, keybinds).
- Created `js/data.js` (elements, rarity, 224 weapons, skills, blessings, enemies, bosses, biomes, stats, shop, echoes, difficulties).
- Created `js/pixel.js` (bitmap font, weapon/element/resource/skill icon generation, knight/enemy/boss sprites, props).
- Created `js/audio.js` (WebAudio chiptune tracks + many SFX).
- Created `js/world.js` (dungeon graph, room generation, collisions).
- Created `js/render.js` (title/town scenes, room rendering, lighting, ambient particles, minimap).
- Created `js/entities.js` (Player, Enemy, Boss, Projectile, Particle, FloatText, Pickup).
- Created `js/input.js` (keyboard, mouse, touch joystick, action queue).
- Created `js/game.js` (core loop, town/dungeon flow, combat, skills, loot, rewards, save hooks).
- Created `index.html` (title, town, HUD, modal, boss intro, toasts, boot markup).
- Created `css/style.css` (full pixel UI, responsive/mobile styling).
- `screenshots/` directory created.

### Active
- `js/ui.js` has NOT been created yet.
- `js/main.js` has NOT been created yet.
- Runtime integration, syntax validation, browser testing, and visual screenshots are pending.

### Blocked
- Game cannot boot until `js/ui.js` and `js/main.js` exist because `index.html` loads `js/main.js`.
- Likely import/runtime issues still need fixing (see Important Context).

## Next Move
1. Create `js/ui.js` implementing the full UI API expected by `game.js`.
2. Create `js/main.js` with default meta/save-load logic, UI/Game/Audio/Input wiring, canvas sizing, boot removal, and global debug hook.
3. Run syntax checks (`node --check`) and start the static server on port 3002.
4. Use Playwright to load, click `PLAY`, verify title/town/gameplay, capture desktop (1440×900) and mobile (390×844) screenshots, and inspect visually.
5. Fix visual/functional bugs, then run repeated screenshot verification.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: central game logic; defines exact UI method contract.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: all balancing/data; 224 weapon generation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render.js`: exports `TOWN_HOTSPOTS`, `TOWN_COLLIDERS`, `TOWN_BOUNDS`, minimap/lighting functions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/entities.js`: Player/Enemy/Boss/Projectile behavior.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/pixel.js`: icon URL generators and sprites used by UI.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/input.js`: joystick/action queue; UI must call `input.queue(...)`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: audio engine and settings.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: room/dungeon generation and collisions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all required DOM IDs/classes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: existing UI styling/components.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/assets/fonts/press-start-2p.woff2`, `vt323.woff2`: bundled fonts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: uses runtime default static server.

## Important Context
- Expected UI API used from `game.js`: `ui.showScreen(name)`, `ui.syncTitle(game)`, `ui.updateHUD(game)`, `ui.setTownPrompt(hotspot)`, `ui.banner(title,sub,color)`, `ui.toast(msg,color)`, `ui.showBossIntro(def)`, `ui.hideBoss()`, `ui.showPath(options, game)`, `ui.showLoot(cards, game, fromChest)`, `ui.updateLoot(cards)`, `ui.showShrine(game)`, `ui.showVictory(game, summary)`, `ui.showGameOver(game, opts)`, `ui.showPause(game)`, `ui.openTownPanel(id, game)`, `ui.closeModal()`, `ui.fade(duration, cb)`, `ui.fadeOut(duration)`, plus `ui.blocking` property.
- Game methods called from UI: `game.goTown()`, `game.goTitle()`, `game.startRun({biome,difficulty})`, `game.choosePath(id)`, `game.chooseLoot(card)`, `game.rerollLoot()`, `game.chooseShrine('heal'|'blessing')`, `game.revive()`, `game.returnToTown()`, `game.recompute()`, `game.save()`.
- Game imports currently fixed to get `TOWN_COLLIDERS`, `TOWN_BOUNDS`, `TOWN_HOTSPOTS` from `render.js`; `TOWN_LEVELS` removed.
- `game.onPlayerDeath()` now does NOT commit run; `returnToTown()` commits partial rewards when mode is `gameover`.
- `game.updateParticles()` no longer updates pickups (dungeon updates them once); verify no double-update remains.
- `game.abandonRun()` is referenced by plan but not yet implemented; add it for pause “Abandon Run”.
- `Boss` uses `this.isBoss = true`; `Enemy` has an `isBoss` getter returning false.
- `Projectile` expects `opts.game` (game passes it explicitly).
- Default meta shape must include: `level`, `xp`, `gold`, `gems`, `echoes`, `materials {iron,essence,crystal}`, `stats {str,dex,agi,int,vit}`, `statPoints`, `skillPoints`, `skills`, `equippedSkills`, `ownedWeapons`, `equippedWeapon`, `upgrades`, `collection`, `potions {hp,mp}`, `echo {power,vitality,haste,fortune}`, `settings {autoEquip,sfx,bgm,shake}`, `runs`, `kills`, `bestRoom`, `name`.
- `STARTER_WEAPONS` in `data.js` provides three starting weapon IDs; `whirlwind` should be unlocked/equipped by default so the player has a skill immediately.
- Runtime capture auto-clicks a visible button whose trimmed text matches exactly `/^(start|play)(\s+(game|now))?$/i`; use the existing `PLAY` button.
- Server command used by runtime: `PORT=3002 node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"`, with `RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime`.
- Playwright is available via the preinstalled runtime package at `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright`; run screenshots after starting server.
- Changes are uncommitted; git history has only the initial setup commit.

## Objective
- Build the requested “SOUL KNIGHT PREQUEL: ADVENTURE” as a polished, playable top-down pixel-art ARPG dungeon crawler in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`, targeting desktop and mobile browsers.

## Requirements
- Core loop: Town Hub → procedural dungeon (5–18 rooms) → combat waves → choose 1 of 3 upgrades/weapons → boss → rewards → return.
- Stats: HP, MP, STR, DEX, AGI, INT, VIT; max level 100; 3 skill branches (Warrior, Guardian, Mage).
- Damage formula: `FinalDamage = BaseDmg × (1 + STR/100) × ElementMultiplier × RarityMultiplier × CritMult`.
- 8 elements (Fire, Water, Lightning, Nature, Dark, Light, Earth, Ice) with 1.5× / 0.7× matchups.
- 200+ unique weapons, currencies (Gold, Gems, Materials), crafting/upgrades.
- Pixel-art 16-bit presentation, dark fantasy + whimsical, dynamic 2D lighting, chiptune/orchestral-tinted audio.
- Mobile HUD: left joystick (~100px), Attack (~70px red), Skill 1/2 (~50px), Dodge (~50px blue), HP bar (~200px), MP (~150px), 80×80 minimap.
- Responsive UI, tap-to-attack <100ms, inventory max 3 scrolls, toggleable auto-equip of higher-DPS weapon.

- Dependency-free static HTML/CSS/JS modules (no build step), served on port 3002.
- Internal canvas 480×270 scaled with `image-rendering: pixelated`.
- Bundled local pixel fonts in `assets/fonts/`.

"# MASTER PROMPT: SOUL KNIGHT PREQUEL: ADVENTURE (SKPA)

## 1. Core Identity @COMMENT_BODY@ Elevator Pitch
Buatlah sebuah game Action RPG (ARPG) Dungeon Crawler berperspektif top-down dengan gaya visual Pixel Art 16-bit modern. Game ini ditujukan untuk platform Mobile (Android/iOS) dan PC. Fantasi pemain adalah menjadi seorang \"Knight muda\" yang terjebak dalam time loop, menjelajahi dungeon prosedural yang berubah setiap saat untuk mengumpulkan kekuatan elemental dan mengungkap misteri kehancuran dunia. Gameplay berfokus pada combat real-time yang cepat, koleksi 200+ senjata unik, dan progression RPG yang mendalam.

## 2. Core Loop Mechanic
Implementasikan loop gameplay utama berikut untuk sesi bermain 5-15 menit:
1. PREPARE (Town Hub): Pemain memilih senjata, mengupgrade skill, dan membeli potion.
2. ENTER DUNGEON: Memasuki dungeon prosedural yang terdiri dari 5-18 room.
3. COMBAT WAVES: Mengalahkan gelombang musuh di Combat Room.
4. LOOT @COMMENT_BODY@ CHOOSE: Mendapatkan loot dan memilih 1 dari 3 random upgrade/senjata setelah room clear.
5. BOSS FIGHT: Menghadapi boss unik dengan pola serangan berbeda di akhir dungeon.
6. REWARD @COMMENT_BODY@ RETURN: Mendapatkan Gold, XP, dan material, lalu kembali ke Town Hub.

## 3. Progression @COMMENT_BODY@ Economy
- **Character Stats:** HP, MP, STR (Physical Dmg), DEX (Crit Chance), AGI (Dodge), INT (Magic Dmg), VIT (Max HP). Max level 100.
- **Skill Tree:** 3 cabang (Warrior untuk Physical DPS, Guardian untuk Tank, Mage untuk Elemental).
- **Currency:** Gold (upgrade/craft), Gems (cosmetic/gacha), Materials (crafting).
- **Balancing:** Gunakan formula damage: `FinalDamage = BaseDmg × (1 + STR/100) × ElementMultiplier × RarityMultiplier × CritMult`. Terapkan sistem elemental (Fire, Water, Lightning, Nature, Dark, Light, Earth, Ice) dengan mekanisme kuat/lemah (1.5x / 0.7x damage).

## 4. Visual @COMMENT_BODY@ Audio Direction
- **Art Style:** Pixel Art 16-bit. Resolusi base 320x180 di-upscale. Karakter 32x32 px, senjata 24x24 px.
- **Color Palette:** Terbatas per biome (max 64 warna). Mood dark fantasy dengan sentuhan whimsical.
- **Lighting:** Dynamic 2D lighting dengan normal maps pada sprite utama.
- **Audio:** BGM chiptune dicampur orkestra. SFX responsif untuk hit, dodge, dan loot.

## 5. UI/UX Overview
- **Mobile HUD:** Virtual joystick di kiri (100px). Tombol Attack (70px, merah), Skill 1 @COMMENT_BODY@ 2 (50px), Dodge (50px, biru) di kanan.
- **Top Bar:** HP Bar (merah, 200px), MP Bar (biru, 150px), Mini-map (80x80 px) di pojok kanan atas.
- **UX Principle:** Tap-to-attack harus responsif < 100ms. Inventory maksimal 3 scroll. Auto-equip senjata DPS lebih tinggi (bisa di-toggle).
"
